move: hard clip wipe per shot, rotated push-in settle, captions cycle
how: Three slides stacked with z-index ordering; each new slide wipes in on top via clip-path inset(0 0 0 100%)→inset(0 0 0 0%) with expo.inOut over 0.42s at t = i*D/3, while its .shot settles from xPercent 12, scale 1.18, rotation -6 to rest with expo.out, then pushes in slowly to scale 1.06 linearly for the remainder. The index, name and price text rise out of masks (yPercent 110→0 expo.out) 0.18-0.26s after each cut and shove up with expo.in 0.2s before the next; a progress bar scaleX 0→1 linearly per shot. Slide 3 is pre-set at scale 1.06 underneath at t=0 so the loop reads as 3→1.
adapt: Replace the three shot SVGs with product images and change names, prices, index labels and the tag; slide count changes the loop (D = 1s per shot, zIndex sets and the pre-set last slide must be regenerated). Keep the 0.42s expo.inOut wipe and the rotated settle.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .slide blocks with .shot, .grain and the .ui text stacks from shot.slides, applying the initial zIndex and yPercent sets; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with per-slide t = i*D/n. Scope selectors to el; the immediateRender flags on the first slide's clip tween must be kept.
caveats: clip-path inset animation on full-frame layers
zIndex is set via tl.set, so scrubbing backwards relies on GSAP restoring it
loop depends on slide 3 being pre-scaled underneath at t=0
